customManagers.description: Update the image tag in the README quick start
Tool versions in workflow inputs, below a renovate comment, for example the ShellCheck version of ludeeus/action-shellcheck

packageRules.description: Own image on ghcr.io. Every release publishes the exact build tag (1.14.5-1) next to the moving tag (1.14.5) and latest. Regex versioning tracks only the exact one and orders by the build number. Docker versioning would read -N as a compatibility tag and hide rebuilds.
